استنفدوا (form X)

# اُسْتُنْفِدُوا (ustunfidū) /us.tun.fi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْفَدَ (istanfada)
# اِسْتَنْفِدُوا (istanfidū) /is.tan.fi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْفَدَ (istanfada)
